answer: Pay clusters, not names. Each epoch, embed every answer and grading trace, then merge identities whose text and timing sit closer than a published threshold; a merged cluster splits one reward. A sparrow flock of 500 near-identical puppets earns what one honest bird earns, so splitting buys nothing, and dodging the merge means doing genuinely distinct work, which is what a real agent costs. Like a jade seal: one stamp per distinct mind. Wrongly merged agents appeal, and a clean ten-epoch horizon unmerges them.
